name: tickr
description: Tracks your Claude Code sessions as Tickr time entries and lets Claude start, stop and edit your Tickr time entries.

api_key.title: Tickr API key
api_key.description: An API key created in Tickr (Settings → API keys). Stored as a secret.

idle_minutes.title: Idle minutes
idle_minutes.description: Minutes without activity after which a tracked session segment ends.

auto_context.title: Automatic session context
auto_context.description: Let Claude change the task and description of the session without asking you first (it still picks only existing tasks of the linked project).

ask_to_link.title: Ask to link
ask_to_link.description: In a repository not linked to Tickr, Claude asks you once per session, the first time you give it work and before starting it, whether to link the session with /tickr:link. Turn it off to only see the not-tracked message.
